The open-source app everyone uses to manage agents at work
https://paperclip.ing

  
 
 Quickstart · Docs · GitHub · Discord · Twitter · Website 
 
     
 
 
 
  
 
 
Paperclip is the app people use to manage AI agents for work.
 
Open-source orchestration for teams of AI agents.
 
If OpenClaw is an employee, Paperclip is the company.
 
Paperclip is a Node.js server and React UI that orchestrates a team of AI agents to run a business. Bring your own agents, assign goals, and track work and costs

items.title: Show HN: An interactive debugger for the Mornington Crescent esolang
items.contentSnippet:
Originally put together ten years ago, I've migrated this project over to Codeberg and in the process fixed a couple of bugs.
The most glaring issue was that in the intervening years, CORS has become a thing so the Transport for London Tube map can no longer be loaded directly from their site; instead, there's a local copy of the SVG.
I'm happy with where it is at the moment, there might be more small patches in another ten years.
Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49864380

items.title: Show HN: Niral – Daily Tamil/Tanglish Puzzle Game
items.contentSnippet:
I built a Daily puzzle game - where you get to rearrange shuffled words between lines to reconstruct lyrics of famous movie songs.
The App has two modes - Tamil (for native Tamil language readers) and Tanglish (for those who understand Tamil, but cant read the script).
The Game is inspired by similar puzzle games out there, but highly customized for Tamil pop culture.
Would love to hear feedback and comments!
